mutableWidening.text: '{{source}}' is seen here as '{{target}}', and `{{slot}}` is mutable. Through the wider type anything that is a '{{targetPart}}' can be written there, and the original, still typed '{{sourcePart}}', then holds it: TypeScript accepts this, and it is a TypeError at runtime. Make the slot read-only in the target type (`readonly T[]`, a `readonly` property, `ReadonlyMap`), so the narrower value is only read through it, or copy the value ([...items], { ...record }).
